This civilian '''spaceport''' was situated twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of the [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]] to its north and [[Ackbar City]] to its southwest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. The spaceport was considered to be massive despite the small population of the world. [[Container ship/Legends|Container ships]] delivering [[Grain/Legends|grain]], meat and other produce off world comprised most of its traffic.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

A two-story gray pyramid building served as its terminal for visitors.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
